officialText:
Not more than one license or seal shall be issued to an individual, and no individual shall make or cause to be made a duplicate of such license or seal.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
